power.jaymospowers.resonance.desc: Sound and the Deep Dark's sculk. Hear through walls, break things by finding their pitch, and switch everything around you off with silence.
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.starter: Weak Echolocation: the heartbeats of creatures within 12 blocks pulse on a faint ring round your crosshair
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.ability: Pulse: a cone of sound (5 damage, knocks back, stops shields, eating and drinking, shatters panes)
power.jaymospowers.resonance.swallowed: the Pulse, a cone of sound
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.ability: Pulse: a cone of sound that spreads sculk where it lands
Shatter (hold): hum at a block until it breaks (not obsidian), or strip a creature's armour
Echolocation: every creature within 32 blocks glows through walls for you, 4 s (others see the ping)
Hush: a 6-block dome of silence for 5 s; other players' power keys go dead inside
Hush: a dome of silence for 5 s that deafens you too
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.mode: Throw Voice: a sound at the block you look at; creatures go to it (hold %5$s and scroll: pick the sound)
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.special: Tune (hold and scroll): low knocks back harder and breaks stone faster; high hits harder and strips armour faster (tap: back to the middle)
power.jaymospowers.resonance.key.ultimat: Sonic Boom: the Warden's beam, 20 blocks, through armour and shields
Shriek: Darkness on everything within 16 blocks, you hear their hearts, and Wardens come for you
message.jaymospowers.resonance_no_pitch: It has no pitch you can find.
message.jaymospowers.resonance_too_deep: Its pitch is too deep to reach.
message.jaymospowers.resonance_voice_now: Nothing there to throw your voice at.
message.jaymospowers.resonance_cured: The last note fades, and the shrieking in you fades with it.
Strike it to hear every heartbeat nearby.
item.jaymospowers.resonance_resonant_for: Strike it to hear every heartbeat nearby.
It hums in tune with something deep below.
death.attack.jaymospowers.resonance_soni: %1$s was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek
